data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows a horizontal list with next/previous buttons.
data.what_it_does: It renders a row of child widgets that can be scrolled horizontally. Navigation is provided by optional next and previous icon buttons, with optional manual scrolling and animation control.
use_when: You need a simple carousel-like list without external paging logic
You want built‑in next/previous buttons and easy customization of icons and animation
avoid_when: You require lazy loading or infinite scrolling for large data sets
You need advanced paging, snapping, or complex animations
You need platform‑specific carousel features not provided
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just add the widget
Built‑in next/previous controls and customizable icons
Supports manual scroll toggle and simple animation parameters
weaknesses: Limited to small static lists – no lazy loading
No advanced carousel features like snapping or infinite scroll
Customization is limited to provided parameters
data.minimal_example:
HorizontalListView(
  width: double.maxFinite,
  height: 200,
  list: [Text('Text 1'), Text('Text 2')],
  iconNext: Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios),
  iconPrevious: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
  curveAnimation: Curves.bounceIn,
  durationAnimation: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
  enableManualScroll: true,
  onNextPressed: () => print('On next pressed'),
  onPreviousPressed: () => print('On previous pressed'),
);
